# Whole original-AST first sources

Prepared and unexecuted informed study for the next substantive common source
judgment. This packet changes no production, stdlib, corpus, original record,
public contract or Issue. Predictions are explicitly retained as predictions in
predictions.json; no expected stdout or invented failure is supplied.

Eighteen complete independent projects under attempt-01 use schema 2 and edition
2026. Their ordered case inventory and exact source hashes are in
session.before.json; manifest/source/record identities are in first-files.json.
Do not modify frozen first bytes. A genuine syntax mistake or semantic failure
must remain in the first capture and any repair belongs in a full second attempt.
No session.json is published before actual first captures.

Cases cover mixed qif(id,s) plus unused generic Nat/fold, a private duplicate
zero-width owner in a zero fold, a dead-arm missing Adjoint, private total/bad
Basis results, formal Controlled versus Apply-only qif, wrong qif effect/tree,
existing unary versus multiple-argument computed predicates, legal/illegal owner
rebinding, static/global shadow identity and unresolved static/runtime policy.
The bundled import control records existing loader behavior. registry-inputs.json
pins all four exact ordinary std sources and their actual registry pseudo-paths;
the files are neither copied nor edited and no std namespace is injected.

Prospective capture shape: the same eighteen literal cases, each with finite
project check and selected check of main::main using only that original main.qli,
in text and JSON (72 checks). Root must first finish the Formals commit/CLI
barrier, then choose/freeze an actual CLI/native input map and reviewed bounded
collector. No command/collector or new binary map is frozen by this packet.
Use original project/source paths, record raw status/stdout/stderr and forwarder
invocation attempts honestly, and keep all early projection/profile refusals.
Only checks are proposed; no closed generic execution or native acceptance is
inferred from the empty main. Direct checking of the four registry ASTs requires
a later actual original-source judgment, not user-supplied std module injection.

Current static-shadow and module policy differences need a concrete ordinary
before-code choice by root. Both design notes are candidates, not adoption.
The required implementation replaces both real source policies over whole
original ASTs and complete declarations; another helper or union of profile
successes is insufficient. Concrete eligibility, cleanup/injectivity/Meaning,
provider/artifact and independent native gates remain mandatory.
